topic: How does the 45° scan range affect link budget calculations for edge-of-coverage users compared to broadside beams?
response: The 45° scan range increases scan losses, affecting link budget calculations for edge-of-coverage users. Broadside beams have lower scan losses compared to scanned beams.
reference_context: Scan range and beam pointing directions impact antenna performance, with broadside beams having lower scan losses than scanned beams at 45°.
